''Oceanside'' is a Bloodline game taking place on the [http://forums.penny-arcade.com/showthread.php?t=89547 Penny Arcade forums].  The basic goal is to create an underwater city of clear glass (think Bioshock).  Accomplishing this, however, is the hard part.
